panels.title: Nodes serving
panels.description: dedi_up is 1 only when the node can reach its database. A node answering HTTP while failing every lookup reads as 0 here.

panels.title: Cluster leader
panels.description: Should be exactly 1. Zero means no writes are possible; more than one means a split brain.

panels.title: Entries behind the furthest-ahead replica
panels.description: The cross-replica comparison a single replica cannot make about itself. Its own lag_entries can read 0 while this climbs.

panels.title: Seconds since the leader last made contact
panels.description: The signal lag_entries cannot give: a partitioned replica freezes its commit index alongside its applied one and reports zero lag. 0 on the leader, -1 if it has never heard from one.

panels.title: Checkpoint age
panels.description: Reported, not gated: the checkpointer writes nothing while the tree is unchanged, so an old checkpoint on a quiet registry is correct. -1 means the node has never signed one.

panels.title: Log entries
panels.description: Entries in each node's append-only log. The ring nodes are independent operators, so their sizes differ legitimately.

panels.title: Requests served
panels.description: Rate by status class. The dashboard's own polling and health probes are excluded at the node.

panels.title: Peer reachability
panels.description: Each node's own view of its peers. A ring whose members have quietly become unreachable still renders as a ring in the UI.
